items.title: Presentation: Zero Trust Agent Systems that Pass Audits and Still Ship
items.blurb: Advait Patel shares a playbook for securing AI agent systems in production. He discusses moving defense boundaries from the prompt to the tool layer, enforcing scoped workload identities, and mitigating prompt injection via tool outputs.

items.title: yr: DSL meant to reduce boilerplate
items.blurb: Hello, everyone. In 2021 I had a household accident and broke my humerus, and the recovery took a long time. I had a few clients, and they kept coming from the same niche, so I ended up with a lot of boilerplate.
